idea.heading: nw setup permissions: install/check canonical Claude Code allow rules (nw queue/mailbox/campaign/idea/spec, gh pr read-only) in ~/.claude/settings.json; dry-run diff then --yes; conductor-launch warns when missing, never edits settings itself
idea.log:
*** [2026-11-01 Sun 10:46]
2026-11-01 human (conductor session): stewards need the same allow rules as the conductor for conflict resolution and PR rebasing, notably lease-pinned force-push (git push --force-with-lease=nw/<branch>) from rebase worktrees to nw/* PR branches, plus gh pr read/edit. Auto mode blocked the comfort-assistant steward (PR 9/10) and blocks agents from editing their own settings, so rules must be installed by a human-run command: extend nw setup permissions (and nw skills install per SPEC-0320) with a steward set, not only the conductor set.

verdict.title: `nw setup permissions`: install/check the canonical conductor and steward allow rules (dry-run diff, then `--yes`); launchers warn when missing
verdict.summary: Wrote SPEC-0352 (proposed). It adds `nw setup permissions` with conductor and steward rule sets, a dry-run diff by default, `--yes`, `--check` and `--json`. `conductor-launch` and `steward-launch` warn when rules are missing and never edit settings. `spec_lint` reports only the stale generated LEDGER block, which nightwright regenerates.
